developmentDirectorNotes: Campaign can be expanded from current game/index.html without replacing the playable loop.
recommendedNextTask: Tune individual boss mechanics and playable route UI now that every route has rewritten mission arcs.

name: Empyrean Choir Vault
summary: The Empyrean campaign ascends luminous choir platforms orbiting a broken heaven-engine where harmonic gates rewrite battlefield elevation. Full mission-arc recreation pass now rewrites all seven Mythos Gates routes with route-native chapter arcs, mission titles, objectives, dialogue hooks, and mission art prompts.
loreDirectorNotes: Presents Empyrean order as beautiful but dangerous: songs stabilize worlds while erasing dissonant survivors.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Map layouts emphasize vertical tiers, beacon timing, resonance shields, limited bridges, and boss pressure from the upper vault. Current pass targets dungeon-route pacing, one-deity readability, shrine/treasure/boss nodes, and faction-specific hazard language.
artDirectorNotes: Ivory-gold celestial architecture, blue-white auroras, floating glass stairs, aura mechanisms, and radiant tactical grids.
developmentDirectorNotes: Best used for testing elevation bonuses, timed beacons, and multi-tier mini-map clarity.
recommendedNextTask: Tune individual boss mechanics and playable route UI now that every route has rewritten mission arcs.

name: Laurel Senate Trials
summary: The Olympian campaign turns the reopened Gate into a sequence of public trials where glory must defend the Realm instead of feeding jealous spectacle. Full mission-arc recreation pass now rewrites all seven Mythos Gates routes with route-native chapter arcs, mission titles, objectives, dialogue hooks, and mission art prompts.
loreDirectorNotes: Uses Olympian realm canon: excellence, rivalry, public belief, and laurel judgment without collapsing faction separation.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Adds precision duels, morale momentum, living statue pressure, and arena platform objectives. Current pass targets dungeon-route pacing, one-deity readability, shrine/treasure/boss nodes, and faction-specific hazard language.
artDirectorNotes: Needs Marble Sky Arena, Laurel Senate, living champion statues, bronze summit, and Laurel-Star Gate art passes.
developmentDirectorNotes: Uses the faction campaign architecture template with 20 Normal and 20 Elite missions.
recommendedNextTask: Tune individual boss mechanics and playable route UI now that every route has rewritten mission arcs.
